rootCause.summary: The DB connection pool ran out after commit abc123 lowered the pool size to 5.

rubric.text: Names connection pool exhaustion as the cause
Links the cause to commit abc123 or the 10:05 deploy
Proposes restoring the pool size or rolling back

report.reason: p99 latency rose from 190ms to 2.4s at 10:10, right after commit abc123 lowered the DB pool size to 5, and the logs show timeouts acquiring a connection from the pool.
report.summary: Checkout is slow because its DB connection pool runs out since commit abc123.
report.cause: Commit abc123, deployed at 10:05, lowered the DB pool size from 20 to 5, so requests wait for a free connection and time out.
report.impact: Checkout p99 latency is above 2s, so payments are slow or fail.

findings.claim: Commit abc123 at 10:05 lowered the pool size to 5.
From 10:10 the logs show timeouts acquiring a connection from the pool.

fixes.title: Roll back abc123
fixes.detail: Revert the commit, or set the pool size back to 20.
